\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{نرم} \fa{افزار} (narm afzâr)}{نرم افزار (narm afzâr)}]{\fa{نرم} \fa{افزار} (narm afzâr) — software}

\label{lesson:FA-C418-narm-afzar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for access, then the Persian for virtual.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{نرم} \fa{افزار}}
\textbf{\fa{نرم} \fa{افزار}} (\emph{narm afzâr}) — \textquotedblleft{}software\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{نرم} \fa{افزار} \fa{رایگان} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{in narm afzâr râygân ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This software is free.
\end{quote}

\emph{Narm} \textquotedblleft{}soft\textquotedblright{} + \emph{afzâr} \textquotedblleft{}tool\textquotedblright{}. Also an app.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{نرم} \fa{افزار}} is a modern native calque of English \emph{software}, built from \emph{narm} \textquotedblleft{}soft\textquotedblright{} + \emph{afzâr} \textquotedblleft{}tool, equipment\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{سخت} \fa{افزار} (sakht afzâr)}{سخت افزار (sakht afzâr)}]{\fa{سخت} \fa{افزار} (sakht afzâr) — hardware}

\label{lesson:FA-C418-sakht-afzar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for virtual, then the Persian for software.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{سخت} \fa{افزار}}
\textbf{\fa{سخت} \fa{افزار}} (\emph{sakht afzâr}) — \textquotedblleft{}hardware\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{کامپیوتر} \fa{من} \fa{سخت} \fa{افزار} \fa{قدیمی} \fa{دارد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kâmpyuter-e man sakht afzâr-e qadimi dârad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My computer has old hardware.
\end{quote}

\emph{Sakht} \textquotedblleft{}hard\textquotedblright{} + \emph{afzâr} \textquotedblleft{}tool\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{سخت} \fa{افزار}} is a modern native calque of English \emph{hardware}, built from \emph{sakht} \textquotedblleft{}hard\textquotedblright{}, which EtymDB traces to Middle Persian, + \emph{afzâr} \textquotedblleft{}tool\textquotedblright{}.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آپلود} \fa{کردن} (âplod kardan)}{آپلود کردن (âplod kardan)}]{\fa{آپلود} \fa{کردن} (âplod kardan) — to upload}

\label{lesson:FA-C418-aplod-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for hardware, then the Persian for a computer file.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آپلود} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{آپلود} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{âplod kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to upload\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{ویدیو} \fa{را} \fa{در} \fa{اینترنت} \fa{آپلود} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u vide'o râ dar internet âplod kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He uploaded the video to the internet.
\end{quote}

An English loan + \emph{kardan}. Persian also says \emph{bârgozâri kardan}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{آپلود} \fa{کردن}} joins the English loan \emph{upload} to the inherited Persian verb \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}, the usual way Persian takes in new verbs.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{پشتیبانی} (poshtibâni)}{پشتیبانی (poshtibâni)}]{\fa{پشتیبانی} (poshtibâni) — technical support; backing}

\label{lesson:FA-C418-poshtibani}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a computer file, then the Persian for to upload.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{پشتیبانی}}
\textbf{\fa{پشتیبانی}} (\emph{poshtibâni}) — \textquotedblleft{}technical support; backing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{پشتیبانی} \fa{شرکت} \fa{مشکل} \fa{را} \fa{حل} \fa{کرد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{poshtibâni-ye sherkat moshkel râ hal kard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The company's support team solved the problem.
\end{quote}

\emph{Posht} \textquotedblleft{}back\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-bân} \textquotedblleft{}keeper\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-i}. \emph{Poshtibâni kardan} — to support.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{پشتیبانی}} is native Persian, built from \emph{posht} \textquotedblleft{}back\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{pušt}, + \emph{-bân} \textquotedblleft{}keeper\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-i}. Support is keeping someone's back.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
